item.title: Cruelty trial continues for mother of 2-year-old killed in 2021 and left in Mississippi woods
item.description: BATON ROUGE - The trial of a mother accused of punching her child in the stomach prior to the two-year-old's death continued Tuesday.&nbsp;Lanaya Cardwell, 28, had faced a second-degree murder charge in the&nbsp;2021 killing&nbsp;of her 2-year-old daughter, Nevaeh Allen. However, her murder charge was downgraded to second-degree cruelty to juveniles and other related charges.
